title: Cardinals rookie RB Love "about 50/50" for Week 1 after ankle sprain
dek: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love's Week 1 status against the Chargers is in genuine doubt after suffering an ankle sprain in the Las Vegas preseason opener on August 13. The No. 4 overall pick is listed as "about 50/50" to play, per NFL Network reporting. Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love is "progressing" but did not commit to his availability.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love, the No. 4 overall pick, suffered an ankle sprain in the August 13 preseason game and is "about 50/50" to play Week 1.
bottom_line: The official injury report on September 9 will clarify Love's status; any absence forces Arizona to lean on alternate backs for the season opener, altering the offensive approach planned around the rookie.
body: Arizona Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love is "about 50/50" to play Week 1 against the Chargers after suffering an ankle sprain in the Las Vegas preseason opener on August 13, according to NFL Network reporting.

Love, the No. 4 overall pick in this year's draft, saw significant preseason action in the game where he was injured. He recorded 14 touches: 11 rushing attempts for 58 yards and three receptions for 14 yards. Head coach Mike LaFleur had planned for Love to receive double-digit touches in that game.

LaFleur said on Monday that Love is "progressing" but declined to comment directly on the running back's Week 1 availability. The Cardinals will release their first official injury report for the Chargers matchup on September 9.
